name: milton-auth-mail-throttled
description: milton-auth-mail delivery passes that got a Resend 429 (a pass stops at its first, so at most one each). Counts passes, from the job's JSON line {"message":"auth_mail_pass",…,"throttled":…}. Read by milton-auth-mail.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="milton-auth-mail" AND jsonPayload.message="auth_mail_pass" AND jsonPayload.throttled>0
